title: THE PLAYER IS A NEON GREEN CHEVRON ON THE BIG MAP
why: His order: make the player a neon green chevron on the big map (M) so he is easier to see. It was a gold dot with a facing line, the same gold as the district blocks and the loot marks. Now a neon green chevron pointing where he faces, outlined in ink over a soft green halo.
now: On the big map you are now a neon green chevron pointing where you face.
